title: PR body claims gauge deferrals were recorded in deferred-work.md, but the file has no such entries
evidence: deferred-work.md (entire file, 8 lines): "# Deferred work / - source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-3-2-lane-qos.md` ... - source_spec: `_bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/spec-routing-bandwidth-cost.md`" — no gauge/viscomm entries. PR body claims: "Deferred (deferred-work.md): the loop→feed_drop_sites call-site pin (the pre-existing debug_surface_smoke.sh class — needs a headless app-drive harness); SLA text draw-path pixel pin (app package not harness-importable; folds into the same story)."
detail: The deliverable names a durable deferral register that was never updated — only the two pre-existing entries are present. The two known-limitation pins live solely in PR prose, risking loss.
recommended_fix: Append the two gauge deferrals (source_spec/summary/evidence) to _bmad-output/implementation-artifacts/deferred-work.md, matching the existing entry format.

title: PR body verification counts are stale vs the final tree (91/46 vs actual 94/48)
evidence: "- `odin test app/render` — 91 (83 + 8 new gauge pins: table/tween/chase/ ... - `odin test app` — 46; `odin test core` — 261 (untouched)". Re-run at reviewed commit 7114bf3: "Finished 94 tests ... All tests were successful." (app/render) and "Finished 48 tests ... All tests were successful." (app); the r1 fold commit message itself says "Re-verified: 94 render / 48 app / 261 core tests".
detail: The r1 fold appended its section to the body but never refreshed the verification numbers; they contradict the same PR's own commit message and the actual tree. Misleading for future audits.
recommended_fix: Update the _pr_body verification section to 94 render / 48 app (the r1-round final counts) or annotate the counts as pre-r1-fold.

title: Stale 'Roster cap 8' claims contradict the shipped 16 SLA slots
evidence: PR body: "- **Roster cap 8** on the SLA ease slots (the node_health card's pinned catalog cap); classes beyond it simply never feed — an unfed gauge reads raw (the zero value IS the fallback)." Code: app/render/gauge.odin:96 "sla_ms:   [16]Gauge_Ease, // per-class avg-latency display (ms)"; gauge_test.odin:29 comment "roster > 8 unfed ->" while the same test pins len(v.gauges.sla_ms) == 16; the body's own r1 section says "SLA slots 8 → 16 (the planned roster is 9 classes)".
detail: The pre-r1 'cap 8' decision bullet (and one test header comment) was superseded by the 8→16 fold but left in place — the body contradicts itself and the code.
recommended_fix: Rewrite the 'Roster cap 8' bullet to 'Roster cap 16' and fix the gauge_test.odin:29 header comment from 'roster > 8' to 'roster > 16'.
